scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

DB.description: D1 database for OAuth users, sessions, and account tokens. A new database is created for this deployment.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Generate a unique signing secret with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

WAKATIME_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID from your [WakaTime OAuth app](https://wakatime.com/apps).

WAKATIME_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret from your WakaTime OAuth app. Keep it private.
